browse_hf_dataset_archives: browse the HuggingFace dataset structure and download tar archives using display_hf_browser
download_archive_files: download and extract a tar archive from the Seamless Interaction dataset to a local directory
get_fs_instance: get a SeamlessInteractionFS instance for accessing the dataset filesystem
list_dataset_batches: list available batches for a given label and split in the Seamless Interaction dataset
get_tar_archive_size: get the size in GB of a specific tar archive for a label, split, batch, and archive
